---
title: Restic Backups
---

Restic Backups is a YAML configuration and CLI layer for multiple restic
repositories, with optional SOPS decryption. It supports S3-compatible services,
mounted local storage, multiple repositories and backup jobs, managed private
metadata directories, and a complete macOS Voice Memos workflow.

## Start here

- [Quick Start](quick-start.qmd) creates, validates, and restores a first backup.
- [Configuration](configuration.qmd) describes storage, restic repositories,
  backup jobs, and Glacier policy.
- [Generic Backups](generic.qmd) covers standard restic operations for any local
  files or directories.
- [Voice Memos Backups](voice-memos.qmd) covers backup, transcription, recovery,
  and diarization on macOS.

## Architecture

```text
restic_backups/
  cli.py                 root command wiring and global options
  config.py              YAML loading and validation
  generic/
    cli.py               generic restic command definitions
    local.py             local repository destruction
    sops.py              SOPS decryption
    repository.py        repository resolution and managed paths
    restic.py            restic execution and archive policy
    s3.py                permanent repository destruction
  voice_memos/
    cli.py               Voice Memos command definitions
    pipeline.py          transcription and diarization processing
    workflow.py          backup, restore, and recording lookup
    parallel.py          worker process orchestration
    dashboard.py         live Textual dashboard
```

Command modules contain command definitions and option handling. Config, SOPS,
repository, pipeline, workflow, and parallel modules perform the operational work.

## Private data boundary

Managed artifacts use:

```text
data/<storage-id>/<repository-path>/<job-id>/
```

This path is relative to the selected configuration file. It does not constrain
backup sources; commands may pass absolute source paths outside the repository.
Everything below `data/` is ignored.

::: {.callout-warning}
Commit `config.sops.yaml` only while encrypted. Never commit credentials,
recordings, transcripts, summaries, caches, restores, or restic data.
:::
